questions.markdown:
Make use of functional decomposition to find the minimum-cost circuit for the function 

$$
f(x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4)=\sum m(4,7,9,10,12,13,14,15).
$$

 Assume that the input variables are available in uncomplemented form only.
Demonstrate SR latch (basic Flip Flop circuit) using NAND gates with its function table.

It is required to develop a system to swap the contents of two $n$-bit registers. Assume that a temporary register is available to assist swapping. Adopt state table approach to design control circuit. Control circuit has two inputs clock and $w$. The swapping process is initiated when $w=1$, and on completion the control circuit asserts a signal Done to 1.

i) Derive the expression for the outputs of control circuit.
ii) Develop bus architecture of the system based on tri-state buffer.

A combinational circuit receives two single-bit inputs $A$ and $B$ and produces a single-bit output $Y=F_1|F_2$. The Boolean functions $F_1$ and $F_2$ are as given below and are implemented using a decoder and OR gates. Design a minimal circuit for $Y$ using only one decoder, one 2:1 multiplexer, and OR gates.

$F_1(A,B)=\sum m(2,3)$

$F_2(A,B)=\sum m(0,1,3)$

An efficient scheme for transferring the information between registers in a multiple-register configuration is a common bus system. Design a 4-bit common bus system for 4-registers of 4-bits each using multiplexers.
